versions.content: Semantics of attribute DiagnosticEvent . associatedE- ventIdentification Use cases exist where DiagnosticEvent s are not as- sociated with the DiagnosticTroubleCode but the occurrence of the event shall nonetheless be reported as part of the dtcProps . snapshotRecordContent . dataIdentifier of a given DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds . For this purpose, it is necessary that the tester can identify the occurrence of the DiagnosticEvent by means of the value of attribute DiagnosticEvent . associ- atedEventIdentification .
